excerpt.zh:
首先选中我们的£science_ship£科研船。你可以在星系地图上直接点击舰船或是从总览中选中。

然后在察看星系地图的同时，在左下角的舰队界面点击调查按钮，然后选择一个没有调查过的£system£恒星系。你也可以右键点击一个未调查的恒星系然后选择调查恒星系。

我们的科研船会自动对那个恒星系内的所有天体进行调查。

texts.en:
Begin by selecting our £science_ship£ Science Ship. This can be done by clicking on the Ship on the Galaxy Map or by selecting it from the Outliner.

While viewing the Galaxy Map, click the Survey button on the fleet interface in the lower left corner, then select a non-surveyed £system£ System. Alternatively, you can right-click on a non-surveyed system and select Survey System.

Our Science Ship will now chart a course and survey all planetary bodies within that system.
